newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 749 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 749 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 749 contracts compared with 1,442 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 217 wheat, 277 corn, 215 soybean, 24 soymeal, 13 soyoil, one oat, one wheat call and one soybean call traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to three cents higher, corn was 1-1/4 cents lower to 1-1/2 higher and soybeans were 1-1/2 cents lower to 1/2 cent higher.
